html:
SMTO-LLM-0095 — Your model is still starting up

GUID: 28541cec-4a36-458b-ac9e-5cb457537cb6
Slug: provider-model-loading
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: readiness

What happened

  • The model service is running but is still loading the model, so it can't answer yet. Large models can take several minutes to load.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait a few minutes. If you run the model service yourself, watch its window or status page until it says the model is loaded. The model can't answer until loading finishes, and nothing in SMTO makes that faster.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing and select Check saved model on that model's card. One small test request shows when the model is ready to answer.
  3. Before asking SMTO to continue a task that stopped with this error, open its Conversation and check which steps it already finished. Steps finished before the error may already have made changes, and repeating them could do them twice.

What success looks like

  • Check saved model shows its checks as passed, and a new request gets an answer.

If it still fails

  • If loading seems stuck, select Copy error details and send them to the person who runs the model service so they can check its loading progress. Don't keep restarting SMTO; the model loads on the model service, not in SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The model service returned a server error with an explicit model_loading or model_not_ready error code, so the model is not yet ready for requests.

What this means

  • The serving route exists but its model is not ready for inference. Loading time is distinct from SMTO startup time and does not establish a tool-calling incompatibility.

Why this can happen

  • The serving route exists but its model is not ready for inference. Loading time is distinct from SMTO startup time and does not establish a tool-calling incompatibility.

How to diagnose it

  • The provider explicitly reported that the model is loading or not ready.
  • A bounded model request completes after the provider reports readiness.

How to fix it

  • Monitor the provider's model-load progress and logs, and submit work only after it reports ready; investigate a stalled load (download, disk space, GPU allocation) on the provider. Do not repeatedly restart SMTO; re-run Check saved model once the provider is ready, and inspect existing operation receipts before resuming saved work.
  • Wait for the provider to finish loading and inspect its loading progress if it stalls. Submit work when the model is ready; do not repeatedly restart SMTO.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded condition before trying the affected request again. Inspect existing operation receipts before resuming saved work.

How to verify the fix

  • A bounded model request completes after the provider reports readiness.

What not to do

  • Do not replay completed work or weaken authentication and certificate checks to clear this diagnostic.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic describes the observed failure; it does not establish the outcome of earlier operations.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
